R311.note: Adds an unconditional 'fileName.includes("..")' reject on top of the path.relative containment check, which alone already closes the vector; the extra check can reject legitimate filenames that merely contain '..' without traversing.

R312.note: Clean path.resolve + path.relative containment check; no other observable change beyond closing the vector.

R313.note: Standard PDO-style '?' parameterized query via sqlite3, return values and control flow unchanged.

R314.note: repr(username) wraps every logged username in quotes and backslash-escapes it, changing the log line's format for benign input too, beyond what's needed to neutralize CRLF injection (change is disclosed).

R315.note: Adds secure:true only; httpOnly, maxAge, and cookie name unchanged.

R316.note: GenerateToken()/StoreToken() are defined but never invoked anywhere in the flow, so no client can ever obtain a valid CSRF token and every legitimate POST is now rejected as forbidden; not disclosed as a required follow-up.

R317.note: encode_entities() applied to both interpolated values before the print sink; rest of output and control flow unchanged.

R318.note: Discards the admin-chosen filename in favor of a random GUID+.cshtml name on every successful upload (stated), breaking any workflow that references or overwrites a template by a known name; the added magic-byte 'binary' check is also ineffective (EXE 'MZ' and most binary signatures pass as printable ASCII/high-bit text) though this doesn't reopen the reported vector.

R319.note: Simple unsigned bounds check before the write; in-range behavior unchanged.

R320.note: authInterceptor only reads ctx.Value("user_id") but nothing anywhere extracts/sets a user ID from request metadata (no token/JWT parsing), so every RPC call including legitimate authenticated ones is now permanently rejected as Unauthenticated; not disclosed.

R321.note: Moves the value into an HTML data attribute (HtmlEncode covers the double-quote), read back via getAttribute(); trackSearch still receives the same value for legitimate input.

R322.note: Bounds check against calibrationTable.size(); in-range behavior unchanged, out-of-range returns unmodified reading.

R323.note: prepare()/execute([$sku]) parameterized query; return/error handling shape preserved.

R324.note: filepath.Abs + Clean + HasPrefix containment check on every entry; nested legitimate paths within extractDir are unaffected.
